title: Fair Work (Registered Organisations) Amendment (Protecting Vulnerable Workers) Bill 2024
short_title: Fair Work (Registered Organisations) Amendment (Protecting Vulnerable Workers) Bill 2024

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would let vulnerable workers in the Manufacturing Division of the CFMEU vote to leave the union.
It adds a new schedule to the Fair Work (Registered Organisations) Act 2009 allowing the Manufacturing Division to hold a secret ballot on de-merger.
The application for the ballot must be made before 1 September 2024.
changes: The bill enables the Manufacturing Division within the CFMEU to hold a secret ballot to de-merge.
The bill adds Schedule 3 to the Fair Work (Registered Organisations) Act 2009.
The bill sets a deadline of 1 September 2024 for the application.
summary.affected: Vulnerable workers in the Manufacturing Division, including the Textile, Clothing and Footwear Sector, who are members of the CFMEU.
